stories.summary: VAST Data’s Glenn Lockwood told SC26 that petabyte SSDs need global declustering plus extra parity to avoid data loss.

stories.title: Get 32GB of DDR5 RAM for $111 in this premium AM5 gaming bundle from Newegg
stories.summary: Newegg’s freshest Black Friday combo deal takes $369 off four premium PC components, including the Ryzen 9 9950X3D, 32GB DDR5-6000 RAM, Asus ROG Strix X870E-E motherboard, 2TB Samsung SSD, and a free MSI AIO for just $1,549.

stories.title: Phison details SSD with a built-in NPU and 64GB of memory that supports AI frameworks on the drive
stories.summary: Phison showed a computational-storage SSD with an NPU and 64GB of memory, plus Mixed Media pSLC and QLC drives, at SC26.

stories.title: Thousands of vulnerable fridges patched against cyberattacks in secret operation
stories.summary: Following devastating hacks that caused European fridges to reach 50 degrees Celsius, destroying food stocks, the U.K. has implemented nationwide patching to ensure similar attacks won't affect its fridges.

stories.title: Jensen Huang question gets reporter ejected from Trump-Xi-Putin summit
stories.summary: Annmarie Hordern, Bloomberg's chief political correspondent and co-host of its leading program, was barred from the historic trilateral meeting between the leaders of Russia, China, and the U.S. after she asked the controversial question.

stories.title: Lawyer’s $9,450 private AI server with 12 used Nvidia V100s now runs every DeepSeek V4.1 Flash expert
stories.summary: A lawyer’s private AI server now runs DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on 12 used Nvidia V100 GPUs, with every expert at 4-bit NVFP4.
